item.title: X challenges $140M fine under Europe's free speech censorship law
item.description: Elon Musk’s social platform X has challenged a roughly $140 million fine imposed by the European Commission under the European Union’s Digital Services Act, arguing the penalty amounts to unlawful censorship that violates its free speech rights. The case opens a closely watched legal fight over how far Brussels can regulate the content practices of major online platforms. #ElonMusk #SocialMediaX #EuropeanCommission #EuropeanUnion #DigitalServicesAct #Censorship #FreeSpeech #Lawsuit #ADFInternati

item.title: Christians praise police officer for defending street preacher's rights
item.description: A female police officer who apparently defended the rights of a Christian street preacher against complaints from a crowd of Muslim men in London has been praised for her actions. #London #streetpreacher #Muslimcommunity #speechrights

item.title: Mexican cartel kingpin 'El Mencho’ terrorized church leaders, forced over 100 churches to close
item.description: The drug cartel leader killed in Jalisco state on Sunday was responsible for the forced closure of more than 100 churches due to threats and extortion demands. #Mexico #drugcartels #ElMencho

item.title: 5 things to know about the SAVE America Act
item.description: The SAVE America Act, which would amend federal law to require “documentary proof of citizenship" to vote, awaits a vote in the Republican-controlled Senate. Here are five things to know about the bill passed by the Republican-led U.S. House of Representatives. #SaveAmericaAct #VoterID #illegalimmigration #voterintegrity

item.title: Vermont stops forcing foster parents to adhere to LGBT ideology, restores licenses
item.description: Vermont has adopted new guidance eliminating a requirement that foster parents embrace LGBT ideology and has restored the licenses of foster parents who had theirs revoked over their religious beliefs, bringing an end to several lawsuits. #Vermont #LGBT #AllianceDefendingFreedom #CenterforAmericanLiberty #Religiousliberty

item.title: Doug Wilson defends appearance at Pentagon, dismisses First Amendment concerns
item.description: Pastor Douglas Wilson recently defended his appearance at a worship service at the Pentagon in Arlington, Virginia, last week, and pushed back against concerns that public prayer in a government space is a violation of the U.S. Constitution. #DougWilson #PeteHegseth #Pentagon #Christiannationalism

item.title: Ann Coulter blasts claim that 'welcoming the stranger' applies to immigration: 'Total fake, phony frauds'
item.description: Political commentator and author Ann Coulter recently dismissed the assertion that the Bible's commands to welcome the stranger and be hospitable apply to U.S. immigration policy. #AnnCoulter #immigration #RussellMoore

item.title: 'Intentionally dishonest': Pastor Allen Jackson responds to CNN’s ‘misguided’ ‘Christian nationalism’ doc
item.description: Pastor Allen Jackson has criticized CNN’s documentary on Christian nationalism, calling the program “misguided” and “functionally dishonest,” arguing that it misrepresents people of faith. #PastorAllenJackson #CNNDocumentary #ChristianNationalism #FoxNews #ChristianRevival #GenZ #FaithinGod #ChristianFaith #ReligioninPublicLife
